column1: # Mod hooks on an event Claude Code's built-in security default sends past the user tier (#875),
# which tools/check-mods.sh lets stand only because they are listed here. Each line: the mod, the
# event, and why it stays, beginning with the issue deciding it. Columns are separated by one tab.
# Each runs on both Macs because each holds /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json
# with {"prependPlugins": []}, which keeps the security default out of first place (#876, README
# "Setting up a new Mac"). On a Mac without that file none of them runs, and claude-sync status says so.
